name: Command Palette (Cmd/Ctrl+K)
requirements: Global shortcut Cmd+K / Ctrl+K with visible keyboard hint badge
ARIA combobox + listbox navigation (ArrowUp/Down, Enter, Escape)
Empty state suggesting recent actions or exact search tips
Focus returns cleanly to previously focused element on close

name: Faceted Data Table & Inspector
requirements: Sticky header, right-aligned tabular-nums numeric columns, mobile card or horizontal scroll shadow
URL-synced filter/sort/page state so links are shareable and Back button works
Geometry-matched skeleton rows during loading + actionable 'Clear filters' empty state
Bulk selection bar appears without shifting layout height

name: Schema-Validated Form & Inline Errors
requirements: Explicit <label htmlFor> on every control; never placeholder-only labels
Inline error below field bound via aria-describedby and aria-invalid
Focus moves to first invalid input on failed submit; user input never cleared on error
Pending submit locks double clicks with aria-busy and stable button width

name: Origin-Aware Slide-Over Drawer / Cart
requirements: Focus trap while open, Escape + backdrop click dismissal, body scroll lock
GPU transform translateX transition <= 240ms ease-out with reduced-motion instant fallback
Sticky footer for primary action (Save / Checkout) above safe-area-inset-bottom on mobile

name: Destructive Action Safety (Confirm or Undo)
requirements: Irreversible deletions open modal naming the exact resource and requiring explicit confirmation
Reversible archives/removals execute optimistically with 5s Undo toast (aria-live='polite')

name: Accessible Telemetry Chart
requirements: Colorblind-safe series encoding (hue + stroke dash or point shape)
Tabular-nums tooltips + keyboard focusable series summary or toggleable data table
Explicit container aspect-ratio preventing CLS during dynamic import

name: Mobile Navigation Shell (375px)
requirements: Collapsible drawer or bottom navigation bar with >= 44x44px hit targets
Zero horizontal page overflow (scrollWidth <= innerWidth) across all breakpoints
Uses min-h-dvh rather than 100vh for full-height shells

name: Optimistic Inline Title / Setting Edit
requirements: Enter commits, Escape cancels cleanly restoring prior value
Optimistic UI updates immediately and rolls back with inline role='alert' message on error
